name: Ingratitude
overview: Scripture reveals the painful reality of ingratitude through various personal and historical examples. In Genesis 31, Jacob recounts his faithful service to Laban despite repeated injustices and changing wages, highlighting the lack of gratitude from a human master. Similarly, Genesis 40:23 records the chief butler's failure to remember Joseph, demonstrating ingratitude even after kindness and deliverance. These passages underscore the spiritual and relational consequences when men fail to acknowledge God's providence and the faithful acts of others.
